description.p: Create Linux virtual machines from local installation media, import standalone qcow2 images, and manage their power and basic resources.
Pirwa uses libvirt and a native GNOME interface. SPICE consoles appear in the main window or a separate window, with virt-viewer as a fallback for VNC and SPICE GL.

screenshot.caption: Manage a local collection of virtual machines

description.p: Allow machines to share a display name while keeping independent identities and storage. Fix installation media ejection, disable Secure Boot by default for new Linux guests, and improve creation navigation, progress, heading readability, machine icons and power menus.
Restore the machine display when returning to Pirwa after inactivity, and recover automatically when a SPICE display surface disappears.
Initial release with local VM creation and import, power controls, resource settings, machine avatars, and embedded or detached native SPICE consoles.
